title: Vague Comment Mumbling on Swallowed Exceptions
pattern: Leaving an empty error handling block annotated with a vague comment claiming that recovery is handled elsewhere, with no concrete code path.
why_bad: It creates an enigma. Future developers cannot tell if the author is comforting themselves about an empty block, warning of a future TODO, or if safe defaults are actually loaded (and if so, who loaded them).
detection: An empty `Err` block containing comments that describe system properties but do not invoke error logging, fallback values, or recovery methods.
counterexample: An error arm that programmatically performs the recovery it describes, e.g. `unwrap_or_else(|_| load_default_properties())`.
fix:
Programmatically initialize the default properties inside the error recovery block.
```rust
let properties = load_properties().unwrap_or_else(|_| load_default_properties());
```
